messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
So I nodded my head and went upstairs.I moved the black bag and put it in my wardrobe.

output.original_text: So I nodded my head and went upstairs.I moved the black bag and put it in my wardrobe.
output.joy: So I happily nodded my head and went upstairs. I cheerfully moved the black bag and put it in my wardrobe.
output.sadness: So I sadly nodded my head and went upstairs. I slowly moved the black bag and put it in my wardrobe.
output.fear: So I nervously nodded my head and went upstairs. I hesitantly moved the black bag and put it in my wardrobe.
output.anger: So I furiously nodded my head and stomped upstairs. I roughly moved the black bag and shoved it in my wardrobe.
output.surprise: So I unexpectedly nodded my head and went upstairs. I quickly moved the black bag and put it in my wardrobe, surprised by how heavy it felt.
output.disgust: So I reluctantly nodded my head and went upstairs. I grimaced as I moved the black bag and shoved it in my wardrobe.
